terbaru.judul: Toward Interpretable Quantum Generators for Financial Returns through Problem-Informed Circuit Design
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a problem-informed framework for financial return generation that uses relational structure and symmetry-inspired parameter sharing to guide the construction of quantum circuits with few trainable parameters and empirically testable operator roles.

terbaru.judul: Online Change-Point Detection in Linear Regression with Autoregressive Errors via Streaming Variational Bayes
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a streaming variational Bayes method for linear regression with autoregressive errors that combines online changepoint detection with sequential posterior inference.

terbaru.judul: Extracting Illicit-Rich Subgraph from Transaction Networks via Feed-Guided Shortest Paths
terbaru.pelajaran: We study investigative subgraph extraction for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) transaction graphs using the Shortest Paths Network Search Algorithm (SPNSA), which aggregates shortest paths among a small input feed of entities.

terbaru.judul: Mixup Barcodes for Topology-Aware Financial Decision Making
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a topology-aware system based on mixup barcodes and persistent homology for financial decision making.

terbaru.judul: On-Chain Archaeology of Bitcoin Oracles: Evidence of Use under Limited Observability
terbaru.pelajaran: This study traces their use and the changing evidence of oracle activity from early days through July 2026.
